text:
**The evidence does not establish whether clearing is happening today.** The latest annual observations extend through 2025, and the reported loss occurred in 2021; no later loss is reported in the supplied evidence.

In 2021, 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss were identified, about 2.23% of the property. Most of that area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted pine forest, with none mapped as native forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches too small to count as an event.

Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting, so it does not necessarily mean permanent deforestation. More recent imagery would be needed to assess activity in 2026.
